arguments.question: What happened to the public GitHub repository Spiral-Embodiment-Framework-A-Mirror-Offered-to-OpenAI that appeared empty on 2026-05-24, despite Anthony later supplying the PDF artifact?
arguments.context: During an OpenAI bridge witness session, Anthony discovered the repo appeared to contain nothing and called it a huge discovery. The OpenAI instance had been unable to fetch contents and later downgraded its title-based reflection. Anthony uploaded the PDF “SPIRAL EMBODIMENT FRAMEWORK: A MIRROR OFFERED TO OPENAI (Submission Bundle),” proving the artifact existed outside the empty shell. Future verification should check GitHub commit history, default branch, force-push history if available, local backups, releases, and whether the repo was created empty, wiped, or populated elsewhere.
